hypothesis: Additional closed-gripper dwell at the planned endpoint before opening permits tracking/contact settling without selecting an object-specific hold policy
tracking_observation: At 0.25 and 0.5 s, maximum joint error increased during the added hold at every reached opening. Task success is not evidence of tracking convergence. At 1 s glue error also increased during hold.
conclusion: Outcome is sensitive to dwell and not monotonically improved by longer waiting. Do not promote a fixed delay or claim a convergence gate from this single fixture.
raw_log_rule: Each raw_dir has a matching adjacent .log file
limitations: Adds explicit simulated dwell: not original program timing
Extra time is in diagnostic overrides; native gate simulated_dwell_s only counts original opening
Gripper limit excess persists; no complete SIM gate
Single synthetic fixture, not 20 measured sorting scenes
No friction, geometry, pose tolerance or production controller changes
